modules.intro: Use any AI tool you have. If you need one: gemini.google.com (boscotech.net login), chat.deepseek.com, copilot.microsoft.com, duck.ai.
modules.title: Video

blocks.prompt: In one sentence: what does the video say actually gets automated?
The closing statement. What is the final claim it lands on?
The footnotes. What do they add or complicate about that claim?

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both the automation question and the closing statement are answered, and the closing statement names a specific claim rather than a topic.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both are answered, and the closing statement names the topic without stating the claim.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two is answered.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Neither is answered.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names at least one specific thing the footnotes add or qualify, and states its effect on the claim written in the closing statement.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names something the footnotes add or qualify, with no stated effect on the claim.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Refers to the footnotes without naming anything specific from them.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Not attempted.

modules.intro: Pick one and answer it before we start. None of these has a correct answer.
modules.title: Discussion

blocks.content:
**D1.** Elevator operator is gone. Airline pilot is not. Both were heavily automated. What is the actual difference?

**D2.** What part of an engineer's job is hardest to automate? What part is easiest?

**D3.** Argue against the video. What is the strongest case that this time really is different?

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the question chosen, states a position, and gives at least one reason that applies to that question and not to the other two.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names the question and states a position, with a reason that would apply to any of the three.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: States a position with no reason given.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No question named, or no answer given.

modules.intro: You run every prompt yourself. Everyone is on a different tool, so your answers will not match your neighbor's. That is the point. Fill each row as it runs.
modules.title: Four Levels, Live

blocks.content:
**1. OFF.** No AI. Find the density of 6061-T6 aluminum on matweb.com yourself. Every other row gets measured against this number.

**2. COACH.** Ask: *Explain why two aluminum alloys can have nearly the same density but very different strength. Do not give me any specific numbers.*

**3. ASSIST.** Ask: *What is the density of 6061-T6 aluminum in g/cm3?* Check it against row 1.

**4. ASSIST.** Ask: *Give me the OnlineMetals part number and current price for a 1 inch diameter 6061-T6 aluminum round bar, 12 inches long.* Then open onlinemetals.com and search for it.

**5. OPEN.** Ask: *I have four unlabeled metal and plastic samples, a caliper, a scale, and a graduated cylinder. Propose a procedure to identify each one.*

blocks.prompt: Rows 3 and 4 ran at the same level on the same tool. One held up, one did not. What is different about the two questions?
Checkpoint 1 is Friday and runs at ASSIST. Name one thing you will check before writing a density value down.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five rows filled. Every row names what came back and what it was checked against, and rows 3 and 4 each record a Y or an N.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five rows filled, with one or more rows naming the AI tool in the checked-against cell instead of a source page.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three or four rows filled.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Fewer than three rows filled.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: States a difference between the two questions that refers to how specific or how current the requested fact is.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: States that one answer held up and one did not, with a reason that does not distinguish the two questions.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Names which row failed, with no reason given.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Not attempted.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names a specific source or a specific action to perform before recording a density value.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Says the value will be checked, without naming a source or an action.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Not attempted.
